jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Driving projects at Sonam Inc
 Sonam Inc operates in the professional services sector, delivering structured solutions within a 50 to 200-person organization based in Berlin. This fixed-term 12-month contract role exists to steer complex initiatives from kickoff to delivery, operating on a 40-hour work week with a 6-month probation period.
 Your responsibilities
 You will own project lifecycles end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder expectations across all phases of delivery.
 Define project scopes, resource allocations, and timelines to ensure predictable execution.

 Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures before they impact delivery.

 Facilitate communication between technical teams, client representatives, and internal leadership.

 Track milestones and maintain documentation using standard project management frameworks.

 What you bring
 Candidates who match most of the following requirements are strongly encouraged to apply, even if you do not check every box.
 Demonstrated experience managing complex projects within professional services or related environments.

 Strong command of English, paired with clear written and verbal communication skills.

 Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams concurrently without losing attention to detail.

 Pragmatic problem-solving mindset focused on measurable outcomes.

 Support and security
 Life & disability insurance is provided to protect you and your dependents.
 Compensation
 The salary for this position ranges from EUR 5,200–6,800 per month.
 Your first months at Sonam Inc
 You will have taken on active project streams, mapped out current operational workflows, and established direct communication channels with your core teams. By month three, you will have shipped key milestones and identified critical areas for process refinement.

Über uns MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

 Lead Product Engineer (a) 

 Deine Aufgaben Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Opportunities früh hinsichtlich Architektur, Risiken, Aufwand und Umsetzbarkeit einschätzen.
 Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
 Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.
 Produktionsreife sicherstellen: Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security, DevOps, Observability, Wartbarkeit und Betrieb von Anfang an berücksichtigen.
 Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
 AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
 AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
 Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.
 

 Das bringst du mit Du hast einen  belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software .
 Du hast bereits  Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen.
 Du hast Erfahrung in einem  Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software.
 Du kannst  offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren , Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen.
 Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst  Ownership für das Ergebnis .
 Du besitzt ein starkes  Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln.
 Du beherrschst die Grundlagen moderner Softwareentwicklung sicher – von  Datenbanken, APIs und Architektur bis zu Testing, Cloud, Deployment, Security und Betrieb .
 Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit  LLMs, AI-Agenten und AI-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie diese mit klassischer Softwarelogik zusammenspielen.
 Du nutzt  Coding Agents und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv und kannst deren Möglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch einschätzen.
 Du verbindest hohe Qualitätsansprüche mit  Pragmatismus . Du vermeidest sowohl

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

 The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. 

 As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

 Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

 Our humble expectations 

 You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

 
 Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 

 It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. 

 Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

 High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.

 Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.

 Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.

 Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

 
 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success  
 Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
 Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
 Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
 Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
 Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 
 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
 IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
 Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
 Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
 Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.

jobs.title: Office Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP Enterprise Technology provides Technology services for WPP, the world’s largest communications services group. As a creative transformation company, WPP is helping its clients transform the future through extraordinary work. WPP ET is an integral part of that journey, and we are proud to provide technology for some of the world’s most creative brands.

Own WPP’s office-technology product set (meeting rooms, room booking, print, signage and building-access technology), retaining WPP control of standards and roadmap while Kyndryl delivers operations.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the roadmap, standards and backlog for meeting rooms, room booking, print and signage.
  • Drive a consistent, reliable and modern in-office technology experience.
  • Govern Kyndryl and AV/vendor operations and approve change.
  • Manage hardware standards, lifecycle and refresh.
  • Partner with facilities and agencies on room and workplace technology.
  • Prioritise demand and continuous improvement.
  • Define the service outcomes, standards and SLAs that Kyndryl and other partners deliver against.
  • Govern Kyndryl performance, manage demand and escalations, and retain WPP accountability for the service.
  • Own the service roadmap and approve partner-delivered change before it reaches production.

 

What you'll need:

  • Product / service ownership for meeting-room and office technology.
  • Microsoft Teams Rooms, AV, signage, print and room-booking platforms.
  • Hardware lifecycle and standards management.
  • Vendor governance and SLA management.
  • Backlog and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrable product or service ownership experience for the relevant technology.
  • Experience governing third-party / managed-service delivery against SLAs.
  • Relevant certifications and/or degree, or equivalent experience.
  • Owns the product/service vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog.
  • Balances user experience, security, cost and operational stability in every decision.
  • Holds delivery partners to account against agreed outcomes and SLAs.
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Uses data and user feedback to drive continuous improvement.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leade

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is at the forefront of the marketing and advertising industry's largest transformation. Our Global CIO is leading a significant evolution of our Enterprise Technology capabilities, bringing together over 2,500 technology professionals into an integrated global team. This team will play a crucial role in enabling the ongoing transformation of our agencies and functions.

Enterprise Technology is looking for an experienced Desktop Product Owner to lead the evolution of our global endpoint services. Responsible for the vision, roadmap and continuous improvement of desktop and device management capabilities, you'll balance user experience, security and operational excellence while overseeing delivery through strategic partners. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong endpoint management expertise with product ownership, stakeholder engagement and vendor governance experience.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the roadmap, backlog and standards for PC, Mac, mobile and VDI management.
  • Drive modern management, zero-touch provisioning and patch compliance.
  • Govern Kyndryl device operations and approve configuration change.
  • Own device security baselines in partnership with Cyber Security.
  • Manage platform health, compliance and reporting.
  • Prioritise demand and continuous improvement.
  • Define the service outcomes, standards and SLAs that Kyndryl and other partners deliver against.
  • Govern Kyndryl performance, manage demand and escalations, and retain WPP accountability for the service.
  • Own the service roadmap and approve partner-delivered change before it reaches production.

What you'll need:

Skill Requirements
•    Product/service ownership for endpoint management.
•    Intune, Iru, Autopilot and VDI knowledge.
•    Device security and compliance.
•    Vendor governance and SLA management.
•    Backlog and stakeholder management.
•    Demonstrable product or service ownership experience for the relevant technology.
•    Experience governing third-party / managed-service delivery against SLAs.
•    Relevant certifications and/or degree, or equivalent experience.

Behaviours
•    Owns the product/service vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog.
•    Balances user experience, security, cost and operational stability in every decision.
•    Holds delivery partners to account against agreed outcomes and SLAs.
•    Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•    Uses data and user feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

jobs.description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany or Rennes, France.

Working with a dedicated Scrum Team, this role turns customer, operational, regulatory and engineering input into a clear product goal, an ordered backlog and valuable, usable increments that can be released and operated safely.

jobs.title: Product Manager  H/F
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Innovation & Design

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.

 

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.

Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.

Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.

Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.

 

Vos responsabilités 

  • Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.
  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.
  • Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.
  • Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.

Compétences et expériences désirées  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.
  • Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.
  • Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.
  • Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos marqueurs distinctifs :

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence

About Ledger 
 We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.
 At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.
 The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.
 You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.
 
 Why Lovable? 
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
 
 Who you are 
 A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.

 Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.

 Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.

 Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.

 Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.

 Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.

 
 What we’re looking for 
 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.

 Experience at a high tech company.

 Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.

 A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.

 Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.
 Preferred: 

 Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io , even if you weren't the one operating them.

 Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.

 Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.

 Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.

 
 What you’ll do 
 Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.

 Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.

 Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.

 Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.

 Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.

 Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.

 Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.

Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.

 Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.

 La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.

 

 
 🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

 Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

 
 Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.

 Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.

 Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.

 
 Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.

 Engagement clients

 Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.

 Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

 Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.

 L'entraide est très importante chez Moka. 

 De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

 Tu es à l'aise à l'oral , et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.

 Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie , organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.

 Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
jobs.description:
Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.

This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.

Day to day, you will:

  • Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.
  • Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
  • Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
  • Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
  • Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
  • Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
  • Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
  • Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.

What you’ll bring

  • A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
  • Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
  • The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
  • Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
  • A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
  • The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
  • The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
  • Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
  • Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.

Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its gover

jobs.description:
The role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Senior Product Delivery Manager at HelloFresh. This role is pivotal to the future of our fulfillment network. You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs.
Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. Once optimized, you will lead the charge in deploying this new operational blueprint into other DCs across our international markets.
This is not a traditional desk-bound product role; it requires a strong operational background, deep understanding of physical process design, and the ability to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Process and Equipment Design: You will actively design, evaluate, and refine DC layouts, operational workflows, and physical equipment setups for our next-generation production models.
  • Project Deployment & Rollout: Working cross-functionally, you will be the driving force for the end-to-end implementation and deployment of production technologies. Including this complex new production model across multiple international fulfillment centers.
  • Lean Management & Continuous Improvement: You will apply Lean principles to continuously test, tweak, and optimize the operational setup and production capacity before, during, and after site rollouts.
  • Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: You will act as the central node between global engineering, local operations teams, tech, and senior leadership. You will manage expectations, align priorities, and ensure smooth execution across a matrixed international environment.
  • Problem Solving: You will identify, prioritize, structure, and solve an array of complex physical and systematic business problems on the shop floor, using analytics, engineering principles, and strong business judgment.
  • Strategy and Planning: You will support the development of rollout strategies and produce the resulting project plans, ensuring that we deploy at scale without disrupting ongoing operations.
  • Documentation and Standardization: You will drive towards clear and structured project documentation, clearly defining and outlining the solutions, requirements, … You will help us create standard deployment playbooks which speed up bringing our solutions to market.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: You have a strong track record within a production, manufacturing, or supply chain environment.
  • Design Expertise: You possess highly specific, demonstrated experience in DC layout design, process design, and equipment design/optimization.
  • Methodology: You have deep expertise in Lean Management principles and continuous improvement methodologies within a physical operational setting.
  • Leadership: You have exceptional project delivery and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and guide teams in an environment that requires intense cross-functional collaboration.
  • Academic Record: An excellent academic record with a degree from a top-tier college or University (Engineering, Supply Chain, or Business degrees strongly preferred).
  • Consulting Experience: Demonstrated experience at an (operational / management) consulting firm with a focus on manufacturing/operations projects is a big plus.
  • Autonomy: You have a demonstrated ability to deliver heavy-hitting impact and work highly independently in an unstructured, fast-moving, and constantly evolving high-growth environment.
  • Mobility: You have an interest and willingness to frequently travel abroad (~50%).

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone
 Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.
 At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.
 I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.
 Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.
 That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.
 You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.
 — Grigory
 
Why Secfix exists
 Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.
 Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.
 We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.
 This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.
 
What you'll actually do in the first 3 months
 This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:
 Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.
 Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.
 Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.
 
What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?
 After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.
 You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.
 Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:
 Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

 Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

 Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next m

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
