Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!  

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS. 
  • Deep understanding of Product-Led Growth, including SaaS metrics, freemium and trial models, and PLG-driven customer j

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Document Domain
jobs.description:
PandaDoc is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Document Experience — redefining how professionals create, refine, collaborate on, and complete documents in an increasingly AI-driven world.

You’ll own the strategy and execution of PandaDoc’s core document experiences, shaping how structured content, collaboration, and intelligent assistance come together into cohesive workflows. Your work will help customers move faster from ideas to finalized agreements by making document creation more intuitive, adaptive, and connected.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of user experience, platform systems, and applied AI. You’ll guide multiple squads, align cross-functional partners, and translate emerging technologies into scalable product systems — balancing exploration with disciplined delivery.

In this role, you will

  • Lead high-impact initiatives across document creation, authoring and collaboration experiences.
  • Shape cohesive end-to-end document workflows, ensuring users can move naturally from drafting to completion.
  • Integrate AI capabilities directly into document experiences — including authoring, refinement, structure, and automation — with a focus on real user outcomes.
  • Define product direction for modern document systems, blending structured content, intelligent assistance, and collaborative workflows.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, AI platform, and core platform teams on APIs, integrations, and data models that enable scalable experiences.
  • Collaborate with other senior PMs to ensure consistent, connected journeys across PandaDoc.
  • Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, customer feedback, and product telemetry.
  • Shape the long-term direction of PandaDoc’s Document Domain, ensuring flexibility, coherence, and readiness for evolving AI-powered capabilities.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of hands-on product management experience in B2B SaaS, ideally across document creation, productivity, collaboration, or content platforms.
  • Proven experience owning complex user-facing domains end-to-end — from strategy through delivery and iteration.
  • Familiar with document systems, structured content, and cross-format editing models (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or AI-generated content).
  • Direct experience shipping AI-powered product features, including defining UX behavior, rollout strategies, and iteration based on real-world usage.
  • Comfortable integrating AI into workflows thoughtfully, focusing on measurable user outcomes rather than standalone capabilities.
  • Skilled in rapid discovery and iteration using prototypes, experiments, and AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency — using AI for analysis, prototyping, and workflow automation, with strong judgment to translate ambiguous AI capabilities into dependable product experiences.
  • Strong communicator who simplifies complexity, frames trade-offs clearly, and aligns cross-functional teams.
  • Pragmatic and execution-oriented, balancing experimentation with prioritization and delivery discipline.
  • Comfortable partnering with deeply technical teams on system design, APIs, and platform constraints.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Horizontal Platform Poseidon
jobs.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

What's Exciting About The Role

This role places you at the centre of Verifone’s payment application strategy for the DACH region. You will shape the terminal application stack that powers one of Europe’s most complex and competitive payment markets — across attended, unattended, SmartPOS, SoftPOS, gateway, and 3rd Party App environments. You will influence product direction across all form factors, drive girocard and next‑generation initiatives like Victa, and own a horizontal product portfolio that touches every merchant segment.

For candidates who want broad ownership, strategic impact, and visibility across engineering, sales, and market leadership, this is one of the most influential product roles in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • BHE Poseidon App roadmap & Book of Work: End-to-end release planning and prioritisation across the DACH product portfolio (Victa series, NEO 2, Engage (until EOL) and future upcoming products) and the software attached to it.
  • Payment methods: Girocard (DK), ICS (International card Schemes, ELV/GLV, APMs, cashback, instalments, in future Wero (EPI) and Digital Euro
  • Customer variants: Like enterprise-specific builds. You know why the same terminal ships six different application variants — and can defend or consolidate that on the roadmap.
  • Estate & terminal management: VHQ 2.0 rollout and adoption, remote update, key management, and certificate management for Verifone and our customers.
  • Certification pipeline: PCI-PTS, P2PE vs non-P2PE, GBIC, DC POS / TA, DK certification cycles — you own the sequencing (not the certification itself) so the sales pipeline never stalls on a missing certificate.
  • Scheme & regulator alignment: Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft (DK), EURO Kartensysteme, Bundesbank/BaFin adjacencies, and equivalent bodies for AT and CH (SIX / EP2).
  • Sales & Ops alignment: Partner to DACH Region management and country sales on Book of Work, feature commitments, and customer escalations — from Partner conferences to enterprise merchants.
  • Engineering & ADC partnership: Tight collaboration with the Poseidon Engineering, and Hardware teams on release readiness, hardware supply topics (spares, EOL), and new form factors.
  • Hardware aspects: Cover the relevant workstreams to make a hardware product sellable in the DACH region.

Skills and Experience We Desire

  • Native or Business fluent German language
  • 5+ years of product management in the DACH/EU payments space — terminal vendor, PSP, acquiring, or network operator.
  • Broad payments fluency: girocard, international card schemes, SoftPOS, APMs, ELV/SEPA — and how a terminal management system (VHQ or equivalent) ties the estate together.
  • Technical foundation: ZVT-H / PSDK / SDI / EP2, EMV kernel, PCI-PTS, P2PE, PSD2 SCA. You do not need to code, but you read Engineering quotes and certification reports on your own.
  • Book of Work discipline: comfortable owning a multi-product, multi-customer release matrix and forcing prioritisation trade-offs.
  • Regulatory instinct: BaFin/ZAG context, DK/GBIC, ZAIT

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft 
 Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
 Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
 Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
 Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
 Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

 Deine Mission 
 KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
 Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
 Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
 Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
 Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
 Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
 Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
 
 Dein Profil 
 Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
 KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
 Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
 Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
 KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
 Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
 Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
 Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
 Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein st

Deine Aufgaben Über die Rolle 
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

 Deine Aufgaben 
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.

 Dein Profil Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
 Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
 Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
 Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
 Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
 Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.
 

 Warum wir? Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
 Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
 Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
 Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
 Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
 Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
 Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
 Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
 Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
 Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 
 

 Unser Standort Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria.  Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Orchestration
jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 About the team 
 Global merchants need better payment performance, resilience and control across providers, markets and payment methods - without building and maintaining the infrastructure themselves.
 We are building Checkout.com ’s next-generation orchestration product: a modular control layer that connects, routes, retries, vaults and reconciles payments across providers through a single integration.
 This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role. You will turn a complex payments problem into a product merchants trust with revenue-critical transactions and financial operations.
 
 What you’ll own 
 Set product strategy for a core part of orchestration, from merchant problem to measurable commercial impact.

 Work directly with enterprise merchants to understand their payment stack and highest-value problems, then turn those insights into a focused roadmap.

 Design reliable experiences across provider connectivity, routing, retries and fallbacks, token portability, reporting and reconciliation.

 Build the foundations: consistent APIs and data models, provider abstraction, observability, auditability and safe change management.

 Lead delivery with engineering, design, commercial, operations, risk, compliance and finance.

 Shape the path from pilot to enterprise adoption, including migration, controlled rollout, rollback and customer co-creation.

 Protect merchant trust by making routing decisions explainable, configurable and provider-neutral.
 

 What success looks like 
 In your first 12-18 months, you will have:
 Shipped a focused orchestration capability used in production by enterprise merchants.

 Built a repeatable discovery and co-creation model with strategic customers.

 Improved payment outcomes such as approval performance, recovered transactions, latency, cost or provider resilience.

 Reduced integration and operational effort for merchants and internal teams.

 
 What we are looking for 
 You understand payments end-to-end - including PSPs, acquirers, credentials, webhooks, settlement, refunds, disputes and reconciliation.

 You have built or scaled API-first, platform or infrastructure products where reliability and operational excellence matter.

 You are comfortable with data such as approval performance, recovered payments, latency, provider health, cost and reconciliation accuracy.

 You are a systems thinker who can simplify complexity without hiding the important detail.

 You can move from merchant discovery to product strategy, technical trade-offs and executive communication.

 You know how to sequence a modular product around the highest-value use cases, take ownership in ambiguity and follow through.

 Nice to have experience 
 Direct orchestration experience is valuable, but not essential.

 Deep experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer platforms or other reliability-critical B2B systems is equally relevant.

 
 Additional Information 
 Bring all of you to work 
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
 
 Life at Checkout.com 
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 
 

 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 
 

 Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. 
 At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. 
 

 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. 
 

 We're looking for a curious Product Manager Intern to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas. to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas.

 Key Responsibilities : 
 
 Customer Insights & Product Development 

 Meet directly with customers to gather feedback, discuss pain points, and validate potential improvements.

 Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback into clear opportunities, and translate them into product recommendations that shape the roadmap.

 Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize enhancements that improve user experience and agent efficiency.

 Align dependencies and facilitate tradeoff discussions with stakeholders across product areas.

 Follow the development cycle end-to-end to ensure we ship the best possible experience in an agile manner.

 Contribute to Knowledge Base articles, FAQs and product demos to support launches and go-to-market.

 

 Product Analysis & Optimization 

 Gather and synthesize usage and performance data from multiple sources (interaction logs, analytics, customer feedback).

 Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities in product workflows, and turn them into more intuitive experiences.

 Use modern data tools and, where relevant, AI/LLM-based approaches to enrich analysis and uncover deeper insights.

 

 Monitoring & Performance 

 Research, recommend and help implement tools and frameworks for tracking key product metrics (e.g. latency, reliability, usability).

 Collaborate with teams to define and monitor KPIs aligned with product goals.

 Help set up dashboards, alerts and reports to support ongoing performance evaluation and decision-making.

 Qualifications : 
 

 Master's student from an engineering or business school or university.

 Fluent in English.

 Comfortable running customer conversations — asking good questions, listening carefully, and following up.

 Comfortable working across teams, aligning dependencies and navigating tradeoffs with peers and stakeholders.

 A first experience (internship) in a product or project team is a plus.

 Knowledge of SaaS, product development cycles, and our business is a plus.

 Why join us? 
 

 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.

jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).
 Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.
 This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.
 You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!
 
 About hyperexponential (hx) 
 At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 
 About the team 
 Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.
 As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.
 The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.
 Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.
 Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.
 Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

 Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally
 Your Role
 This Project Manager will support the development, integration, and operations of our science efforts including experimental projects related to our Omega, Phelix, ELI, and simulation modeling efforts, helping translate technical objectives into executable plans and ensuring delivery across multidisciplinary teams.
 You will act as a central point of coordination between our Science team, engineering partners, facilities, and the company PMO, bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex technical work.
 This role is ideal for someone with project management experience who is comfortable in labs, hardware environments, or R&D settings, and who wants to deepen their technical and program execution skills over time.
 What you’ll do: 
 Plan and track projects, translating technical goals into clear tasks, schedules, and milestones

 Maintain project plans, schedules, and workflows in Jira, and Confluence

 Track progress and follow up with engineers and technical leads on deliverables

 Coordinate meetings, reviews, and planning sessions; document decisions and action items

 Produce clear status updates, dashboards, and reports for division and PMO stakeholders

 Support risk, issue, and change tracking across hardware, lab, and facility-related work

 Coordinate across teams including Science & Technology, Facilities, and external partners

 Coordinate with company-wide PM efforts to ensure compliance with company-wide standards

 Who you are: 
 Master’s degree or higher in Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical field

 Depth of experience in R&D related project management and coordination

 Familiarity with Jira, and Confluence, or similar tools/technology

 Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams

 Clear communicator who follows through and keeps teams aligned

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German

 Nice to have’s: 
 Background in physics, optics, experimental science, or hardware development

 Exposure to lab infrastructure

 Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project management methods

 Comfortable working in hardware, lab, or R&D environments

 What We Offer 
 Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Peec AI
 Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $15M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.
  
 What You'll Do 
 Take new product areas from nothing to shipped, owning the problem end to end

 Define what a brand's presence inside AI search should look like, working directly with our founders and customers on a category that is still being written

 Go broad on the problem space before narrowing on solutions, and hold that discipline when everyone wants an answer immediately

 Partner with Data, Engineering and Design to build and launch AI-native features at scale

 Set the bar for how the product looks and feels, not just what it does

 Own the customer relationship for your product area. Discovery calls, onboardings, and see people actually use what you built

  
 Who You Are 
 3+ building excellent software products, ideally at a startup or fast-moving company

 You have built new products rather than maintained and improved existing ones, and you can point to what you shipped

 Experience shipping AI-powered products and systems that operate at scale

 Genuine design judgement

 Technical enough to work as a peer with engineers and data scientists

 Experience in a product-led growth environment

 You operate with very little direction. You pick up an ambiguous area and come back with a direction

 Excited to be in our Berlin office five days a week

 We care more about what you have built than how long you have been building. If you have fewer than three years but the work speaks for itself, apply anyway.
  
 Bonus Points 
 A design background, or a portfolio of things you have designed yourself

 Previous founder experience

 Background in Computer Science or a technical field

 Previous experience building AI-driven or search-related products

  
 What We Offer 
 Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

jobs.description:

 You will shape the product direction, roadmap, priorities, and release process while working closely with software engineers, our Lead Architect, product teams, and business stakeholders.
 The role is designed to grow into functional and people leadership responsibility for engineers working on the C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite.

 Your responsibilities Own and continuously develop product vision, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for our C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite

 Align C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite roadmap with our wider company and platform strategy 

 Bring together requirements from customers, internal users, product teams, engineering, and management and translate them into clear priorities.

 Coordinate development activities and releases across teams and components, ensuring that individual efforts contribute to a coherent product.

 Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.

 Balance short-term delivery needs with technical quality and the long-term development of the product.

 Drive resource planning, support team growth, and gradually take on functional and people leadership.

 
 Who you are You are a systems thinker who can understand a complex technical ecosystem, connect the individual pieces, and maintain sight of the bigger picture.

 You combine genuine technical curiosity with a strong product mindset and a desire to create impact beyond implementation.

 You bring clarity and structure to ambiguous situations without oversimplifying technical complexity.

 You listen to different perspectives but are comfortable challenging assumptions, setting boundaries, and saying no when necessary—regardless of seniority or role.

 You communicate confidently with engineers, scientists, product teams, customers, and management and build trust across these groups.

 You take ownership, follow through, and proactively address risks and obstacles.

 You lead through trust, constructive feedback, sound judgement, and a genuine interest in helping others grow.

 

 Your profile Several years of experience as a software engineer, giving you a solid understanding of programming and software development.

 Subsequent experience owning or coordinating a technically complex software product, platform, or large-scale engineering initiative.

 Experience developing roadmaps, managing requirements, setting priorities, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.

 Experience coordinating, mentoring, or enabling software engineers; previous formal leadership experience is a plus. 

 A strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, testing, technical debt, maintainability, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

 Experience with capacity and resource planning, including translating roadmap needs into staffing or hiring requirements.

 Hands-on experience adapting SDK requirements, architecture, and product roadmaps to advances in AI.

 Nice to have Experience with C++ development or ownership of a C++-based product or platform.

 Experience with developer-facing products or SDKs.

 A background in medical imaging, computer vision, or another technically complex software domain.

 Ideally, you are based in Munich or the surrounding area and enjoy working regularly from our Munich office, allowing you to connect with key stakeholders in person.

 

 Why us? Shape foundational technologies used across our products and customer projects.

 Work closely with experienced engineers, architects, and product teams.

 Take on significant ownership and grow into functional and people leadership.

 Work on challenging software at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, and AI.

 Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)

Your Mission This is a company built for growth. 
 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.  
 We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. 
 As  Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting. 
 If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. 
 What You'll Own: 
 Technical product strategy & vision  Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities. 

 Discovery, scoping & prioritization  You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. 

 Agile ownership & delivery  You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work. 

 Technical stakeholder alignment  You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle. 

 Experimentation & continuous improvement  You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and  technical  improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up. 

 

 What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience  Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations. 

 Engineering fluency  You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer. 

 Agile ownership  You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is seeking a Product Manager - Solutions to help turn complex aerospace and manufacturing operations problems into AI-native, repeatable, and sellable products.
 This role sits at the intersection of customer discovery, product strategy, AI-first workflows, product capabilities, and go-to-market readiness. You will help identify high-value operational problems across customers, translate them into scalable products, and work with Product, Engineering, Customer Operations, Sales, and customers to bring those products to market.
 The mission is not to build bespoke features for individual accounts. It is to discover repeatable patterns, define product narratives, and shape AI-powered workflows that help manufacturers plan, prioritize, detect risks, solve disruptions, and execute decisions faster.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Product Strategy: Contribute to the product vision for one or more product lines — defining customer problems, users, and the operational moments where Pelico creates measurable value, and distinguishing customer-specific requests from scalable product opportunities. Help define success metrics: operational impact, adoption, time saved, and commercial repeatability.

 Product Execution: Work closely with Engineering, Data teams, Operations Researchers, Customer Operations, and Sales to turn messy operational pain points into clear product capabilities and workflows. Help design flows that combine human expertise, optimization, rules, alerts, and automation, and translate what you learn into reusable product requirements so the work strengthens Pelico's core product over time rather than creating one-off, bespoke builds.

 Customer Discovery & Design Partners: Work directly with enterprise customers and design partners to map workflows, constraints, and KPIs, and to shape pilots into scalable deployments rather than one-off delivery projects.

 Go-to-Market Readiness: Help build the product narrative, demo flows, and proof points with Sales and Customer Success so they can articulate it independently, and turn pilot learnings into reusable GTM assets.

 Outcome Ownership: Anchor product decisions in measurable outcomes — operational efficiency, faster risk detection, planning quality, throughput and execution reliability, and strong, repeatable customer adoption.

 AI as an Enabler: Across the above, look for where AI — agents, copilots, recommendations, and automation — can meaningfully remove manual work or support better decisions, and help define how users interact with it (proactive suggestions, explainable outputs, human-in-the-loop approval).
 

 About You 
 Product Management Experience: 4+ years in product management in Enterprise B2B SaaS, with experience turning complex customer problems into product capabilities or product lines

 AI Product Sensibility: Good understanding of how AI — agents, copilots, recommendations, and automation — can augment experts, automate repetitive work, and orchestrate decisions across complex enterprise operations

 Customer & Domain Depth: Ability to learn complex operational environments quickly, map workflows, understand KPIs, and identify high-value product opportunities

 Enterprise B2B Exposure: Some experience with products or solutions for large enterprise customers, with an understanding of adoption, change management, safety, explainability, and deployment constraints

Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode.  This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is seeking a Lead AI Product Manager to pioneer our agent-first product strategy in Paris. You'll define and build the next generation of autonomous AI agents that transform how aerospace and manufacturing companies plan, optimize, and execute complex supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI in enterprise B2B, creating intelligent systems that make decisions, take actions, and deliver measurable business value autonomously . 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own the product vision and execution for autonomous AI agents — define agent architectures, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and MRO operations

 Lead complex cross-functional AI initiatives — drive discovery of high-value use cases, design agent personas and reasoning patterns, and pioneer agent-native UX paradigms including conversational interfaces and proactive recommendations

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, customer operations, sales, and enterprise customers to ensure AI features deliver measurable value and achieve adoption at scale

 Define the AI product vision and strategic roadmap with VP Product and engineering leadership, balancing innovation with enterprise deployment requirements around scalability, explainability, security, and compliance

 Drive excellence in AI product development — from experimentation frameworks to deployment best practices — championing data-driven decision making and rapid iteration to launch capabilities that deliver 10x productivity improvements to enterprise customers

 
 About You 
 5+ years in product management with 3+ years building AI/ML products, including hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, or intelligent automation in Enterprise B2B SaaS

 Strong technical acumen across agent architectures — including multi-agent systems, LLM-based reasoning, tool use, RAG, RLHF, and safety mechanisms — to collaborate effectively with ML engineers and data scientists

 Proven track record shipping autonomous AI products to large enterprise customers, with experience navigating safety, compliance, auditability, and controlled autonomy requirements

 Outstanding communication skills in English and French — able to articulate complex agentic AI concepts to executives, engineers, and end users alike

 You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what’s possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

 Experience building agent-based products with frameworks like LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures

 Background in operations research, supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace industries

 
 Why Pelico 
 We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

 What You'll Do 

 Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.

 Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.

 Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.

 Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.

 Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.

 Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.

 Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

 Who You Are 
 

 You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).

 This role is based in London or Stockholm.

 For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
  
 Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.
  
 To do so, here are your responsibilities:
  
 OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP 
 Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

 Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

 Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

  
 SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE 
 Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

 Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

 Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

  
 MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT 
 Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

 Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

 Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

 Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

  
 REQUIREMENTS
  
 Must-haves
 Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

 Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

 Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

 Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

 Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

 Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

  
 Nice-to-haves
 Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

 Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

 Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

 Deine Aufgaben
 Du verantwortest strategische und operative Product-Marketing-Initiativen

 Du übernimmst eigenständig strategische und operative Projekte, treibst diese von Start bis Ende voran und sorgst für eine messbare Wirkung auf Wachstum, Produktnutzung und Kundenzufriedenheit.

 Du übernimmst Ad-hoc-Projekte in unterschiedlichen Bereichen des Marketings und bringst deine Expertise und dein unternehmerisches Denken dort ein, wo gerade die größten Chancen liegen.

  
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School

 Du verfügst über erste Arbeitserfahrung oder Praktika in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting

 Du bist kreativ und es fällt dir leicht andere Menschen zu überzeugen

 Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus

 Du besitzt eine natürliche Stärke in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern

 Du hast großes Interesse am Aufbau von Unternehmen und einen ausgeprägten Willen Neues zu lernen

 Du hast eine zielstrebige Arbeitsweise, ein hohes Maß an Proaktivität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

 Du besitzt Erfahrung im Priorisieren von Aufgaben in einem fast-paced Environment und kannst einen 100%-Ansatz beim Arbeiten an wichtigen Aufgaben umsetzen

 Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an Dich selbst und andere und legst eine Can-Do-Mentalität an den Tag die andere motiviert

 Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift

 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

 Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

 Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

 Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

 Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

 Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

jobs.title: Data Product Manager - Core Data Product (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Core Data Product, au sein du Data CoE (centre d'expertise data), recherche un·e Data Product Manager à Paris

DECATHLON accélère sa transformation pour devenir LA plateforme numérique sportive mondiale. Le digital et l’IA sont les moteurs de notre ambition 2026-2030 pour rendre le sport durablement accessible. Au cœur de cette stratégie, la donnée est notre actif le plus critique. Notre défi ? La rendre accessible, de confiance et actionnable afin de pouvoir la mettre à disposition du business et de la stratégie

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Tu seras responsable de définir la vision et la feuille de roadmap d'un produit Data, en encadrant indirectement une équipe de data engineers. Ta mission sera de rendre la donnée facile d'accès et de confiance afin d'accompagner le business à prendre des décisions orientées data!

Tes missions principales :

  1. Stratégie et Vision du Produit Data
    Définition de la Roadmap : Concevoir et piloter la feuille de route des produits de données (algorithmes, tableaux de bord, API de données, plateformes d'IA).

Alignement Business : S'assurer que les initiatives data répondent aux objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise (ex: réduction du churn via le machine learning, optimisation des prix, etc.).

Identification des opportunités : Détecter les cas d'usage où la donnée peut créer un avantage concurrentiel ou améliorer l'efficacité interne.

  1. Gestion du Cycle de Vie de la Donnée
    Collecte et Infrastructure : Collaborer avec les Data Engineers pour s'assurer que les pipelines de données sont robustes et que les sources sont fiables.

Gouvernance et Qualité : Garantir que les données sont propres, cohérentes et conformes aux réglementations (RGPD). Il est le garant de la "vérité" des données diffusées.

Démocratisation : Rendre la donnée accessible et compréhensible pour les utilisateurs non techniques à travers l'organisation.

  1. Collaboration Transverse
    Interface Technique : Traduire les besoins business en spécifications techniques pour les Data Scientists et Data Engineers.

Accompagnement des Stakeholders : Éduquer les décideurs (Marketing, Ventes, Direction) sur le potentiel et les limites de la data.

Agilité : Piloter le développement des modèles de données en mode agile (sprints, tests A/B, itérations rapides).

  1. Analyse et Mesure de la Performance
    Définition des KPI : Établir les indicateurs de succès non seulement pour le produit final, mais aussi pour la performance des modèles (précision, rappel, temps de latence des données).

Analyse d'impact : Mesurer concrètement le retour sur investissement (ROI) des projets data mis en place.

  1. Éthique et Sécurité
    Éthique de l'IA : Veiller à ce que les algorithmes développés ne soient pas biaisés et respectent l'éthique de l'entreprise.

Sécurité : S'assurer que l'accès aux données sensibles est sécurisé et contrôlé.

COMPETENCE TECHNIQUE

Data Product Strategy & Management
Data Governance & Compliance
Business Modeling
Data Architecture
Agile Methodologies
Backlog Management
SQL, Python (for data validation & automation)
Visualization Tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.)
AI/ML Integration and ability to manage predictive models.
Data Governance frameworks and compliance knowledge (GDPR, CCPA).
Real-Time Data Integration (APIs, Kafka, Streaming).
Data Modeling, Business Intelligence Tools (Tableau, Power BI).
SQL, Python, and familiarity with data platforms like Databricks and Snowflake.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

Tes dernières expériences t’ont permis de développer un intérêt majeur pour les problématiques liées au cloud et à la donnée, tout en consolidant tes connaissances en cycle de vie produit (PLM).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Product Management dans un contexte international et technique.
  • User-centric : Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et sais traduire des besoins métiers complexes en parcours utilisateurs fluides.
  • Impact-driven : Tu as une sensibilité forte pour l'écologie et l'éthique environnementale.
  • Analytique : Tu es à l'aise avec la donnée technique et les calculs d'impact complexes.
  • Sportif·ve : Tu es passionné·e de sport et souhaites mettre ton talent au service de sa pratique durable.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille.
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos eng
